qa_pairs.question: Which component has the higher torque specification - the lever to pedal value sender or the pedal value sender to pedal console?
qa_pairs.answer: The lever to pedal value sender has the higher torque specification at 9 Nm compared to 5 Nm for the pedal value sender to pedal console.

qa_pairs.question: What are the type designations for the lever to pedal value sender?
What type designation applies to the pedal value sender to pedal console?
What section of the manual covers the senders for control unit specifications?
Which BMW model types does the pedal value sender to pedal console NOT apply to that the lever to pedal value sender does?
qa_pairs.answer: The pedal value sender to pedal console does not apply to E36, while the lever to pedal value sender does.
